translations.translatedText: Recep Tayyip Erdoğan won the presidential election in Turkey. Renting a summer cottage is common nowadays. The City of Helsinki is planning a place for houseboats in Herttoniemi. Artists are painting buildings that will soon be demolished. The weather is getting warmer.
